svg.title: Ktemata r6 airbrush scheme - BEARING
svg.desc: R6 PROTOTYPE, not paint-ready: the proposed 3 mm trace at x = 215.5 crosses from the keyboard lid to the display frame. It is clipped by the current component envelopes, but this is not a final clearance proof. Verify the lane, gateway and port rings against measured R6 geometry before cutting.
